svg.title: Save, capability and responsive state contracts
svg.desc: Original specification diagram with synthetic data. Proposed behavior, not implemented GUI or a vendor screenshot.
svg.text: STATE CONTRACTS / ORIGINAL SYNTHETIC REVIEW BOARD
Dirty document / blocking prompt
Unsaved: T-Model - rehearsal
Save new copy | Discard | Cancel
Tab cycles only these three actions. Default focus: Cancel;
restore invoker on cancel. Background edit and navigation stay
blocked.
Proposed contract; verify future egui implementation separately.
Failed save / keep work
Copy not saved: destination exists
Choose new path | Cancel
Keep document dirty and retain the pending action. Never imply
overwrite or successful save. No operation continues after
failure.
Proposed contract; verify future egui implementation separately.
Successful save / pending action
Saved new copy: rehearsal-02.vwp
Continue guarded pending action
Success text appears only after the existing atomic save API
returns success. A cancelled picker is not success.
Proposed contract; verify future egui implementation separately.
Empty local library
No local presets in this family
Open local file
A malformed file preserves the prior document and selection.
Search and empty results never imply cross-family conversion.
Proposed contract; verify future egui implementation separately.
Unsupported model / hardware locked
Parameter definition unverified
Raw ID visible / hardware access locked
Separate unsupported editing from offline hardware lock. Both
reasons are reachable by keyboard. No backend initialization.
Proposed contract; verify future egui implementation separately.
Compact layout / 150% and 200%
1024 x 768 logical: Library drawer
32 target / 20 line / 2 focus border
Stack inspector columns; keep values and units visible. Long
labels wrap, filenames reveal full paths on focus. No text below
Proposed contract; verify future egui implementation separately.
Focus is an outline; selection has a marker + label. Neither is conveyed by color alone.
